name: hcportal_getCategoryDetail
description: Older drill-down for the admin portal dashboard (superseded by hcportal_getCategoryDetail2, which returns different shapes for categories 7 and 8). Returns ONE rowset of raw typed columns for @categoryId: 0=New Hashers, 1=Event RSVPs, 2=New Events, 3=New Kennels, 4=App Logins, 5=Payments, 6=Portal Access, 7=Errors, 8=HashRuns.Org Traffic, 100=Version Adoption. An unknown categoryId returns no rowset at all. Window: @days days (0 or NULL = 60 minutes). READ UNCOMMITTED with NOLOCK hints and OPTION (RECOMPILE). Auth: HC6.ValidatePortalAuth (NULL callerParamString); no permission gate. Permission (2026-10-13): platform admins with CanViewMonitor only; otherwise {Success 0, 'Not authorised to view the monitor'}.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Auth: device ID used to look up the authenticated user and device secret. Validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Auth: short-lived cryptographic token validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth.

parameters.name: categoryId
parameters.description: Required. Category to retrieve: 0=New Hashers, 1=Event RSVPs, 2=New Events, 3=New Kennels, 4=App Logins, 5=Payments, 6=Portal Access, 7=Errors, 8=HashRuns.Org Traffic, 100=Version Adoption. NULL returns an error.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Lookback window in days, default 7. 0 or NULL means the last 60 minutes. The cutoff is GETDATE() (datetime2, UTC on Azure SQL) minus @days × 1440 minutes.

parameters.name: hcVersion
parameters.description: Category 100 only: substring the login's HcVersion must contain (LIKE '%…%'). NULL makes the category return no rows.

parameters.name: hcBuild
parameters.description: Category 100 only: second substring HcVersion must contain. NULL makes the category return no rows.

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: Returned instead of data on auth failure, NULL @categoryId ('Null categoryId') or a runtime error.

columns.name: ErrorMessage
columns.description: Auth error text, 'Null categoryId', or ERROR_MESSAGE()

rowsets.name: Category0_NewHashers
rowsets.description: categoryId = 0. Hashers created in the window (Hasher.createdAt), newest first. UNION ALL of hashers with no HomeKennelId and hashers joined to their home kennel.

columns.name: homeKennelName
columns.description: Home kennel's KennelName; NULL when the hasher has no HomeKennelId

columns.name: cityFullName
columns.description: City.CityFullName of the HC.City nearest the hasher's HomeGeolocation; NULL when HomeLatitude is the 51.5033 default (London placeholder) or no geolocation

rowsets.name: Category1_EventRsvps
rowsets.description: categoryId = 1. HasherEventMap rows updated in the window, newest first.

columns.name: displayName
columns.description: Hasher.DisplayName when VirginVisitorType = 0, else HasherEventMap.DisplayName NVARCHAR(120)

rowsets.name: Category2_NewEvents
rowsets.description: categoryId = 2. Events created in the window (Event.createdAt), newest first, removed runs included.

columns.name: eventStartDatetime
columns.description: CONVERT(datetimeoffset(7), Event.EventStartLocal): the local wall-clock start presented with a +00:00 offset — not an instant. EventStartLocal (persisted computed DATETIME2(7)) is not in db/schema/tables; its definition is in db/hc6/app/archive/deprecate_fb_datetime_in_hc6.sql.

rowsets.name: Category3_NewKennels
rowsets.description: categoryId = 3. Kennels created in the window, newest first (INNER JOIN City: kennels without a CityId are omitted).

rowsets.name: Category4_AppLogins
rowsets.description: categoryId = 4. HC.LaunchAndLogin rows in the window, newest first, excluding two hard-coded hasher ids (0CDBB109-…, D0B7EF01-…). Rows with a NULL UserId are also excluded (the <> test is UNKNOWN for NULL).

rowsets.name: Category5_Payments
rowsets.description: categoryId = 5. HC.Payment rows created in the window, newest first.

columns.name: displayName
columns.description: Payer Hasher.DisplayName when VirginVisitorType = 0, else HasherEventMap.DisplayName

columns.name: cancelledByDisplayName
columns.description: DisplayName of Payment.CancelledBy_UserId; NULL when not cancelled

columns.name: currencySymbol
columns.description: COALESCE(Kennel.CurrencySymbol, Country.CurrencySymbol); '^' marks where the amount goes

rowsets.name: Category6_PortalAccess
rowsets.description: categoryId = 6. HC.PortalAccess rows in the window, newest first, excluding the two hard-coded hasher ids.

columns.name: kennelName
columns.description: The hasher's home Kennel.KennelName (not the kennel accessed)

rowsets.name: Category7_Errors
rowsets.description: categoryId = 7. HC.ErrorLog rows in the window (updatedAt), newest first.

rowsets.name: Category8_HashRunsTraffic
rowsets.description: categoryId = 8. LOG.GeneralLog rows with LogSource 'HashRuns.Org Event List' or 'HashRuns.Org Single Event' in the window, newest first.

columns.name: kennelName
columns.description: Kennel of the event whose PublicEventId = GeneralLog.StrParam1

rowsets.name: Category100_VersionAdoption
rowsets.description: categoryId = 100. One row per user who logged in during the window and has at least one LaunchAndLogin row whose HcVersion contains both @hcVersion and @hcBuild; ordered by total logins in the window, descending. Empty when either filter is NULL.

columns.name: updatedAt
columns.description: The user's latest LoginDate in the window (any version)

columns.name: hcVersion
columns.description: LaunchAndLogin.HcVersion of the user's newest login matching the version filter

columns.name: twoWeekCount
columns.description: All the user's logins in the window (named for the default two-week tile, but follows @days)

columns.name: thisVersionCount
columns.description: The user's logins in the window matching the version filter

sideEffects: Calls HC6.nonApi_portalKennelAccess (read-only) for its permission check.

codeSmells.issue: CATCH does not log to HC.ErrorLog
codeSmells.detail: The CATCH block (line 346) returns the envelope without an HC.ErrorLog row; getCategoryDetail2 was fixed on 2026-10-05, this copy was not.

Two hasher GUIDs (0CDBB109-…, D0B7EF01-…) are excluded by literal in several categories (e.g. lines 200-201, 256-257), and category 0 treats HomeLatitude 51.5033 as 'no home location'. Undocumented magic values.

Categories 0-6 and 100 are verbatim copies of getCategoryDetail2 (lines 80-260, 305-343). Two copies of the same queries drift — the CLAUDE.md HC3 forking warning. If no client still calls this SP it is a candidate for removal.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change the meaning of categoryId values (0-8, 100)
Never change the column shape of any category without updating all portal callers
